items.title: Christopher Nolan Previews DGA's Next Phase of AI Protections: 'It's Down to the Studios'
items.excerpt: Christopher Nolan applauded the DGA and AMPTP for coming to the table and negotiating "excellent language and guardrails" against AI.
items.rationale: Labor policy signal: the DGA president sets out what the guild's AI guardrails cover and what it now expects studios to enforce. Picked over the Deadline write-up of the same remarks (cluster c2).

items.title: 'Pokemon' Anime Studio OLM Trains AI Coloring Tool on Just Three Frames in Japan Government-Backed Project
items.excerpt: OLM Digital's Yotsukura Tatsuo shared results of Japan's government-backed ANIMINS anime AI project at Taiwan Creative Content Fest.
items.rationale: Concrete production result: a coloring model trained on only three frames, from a major anime studio's government-backed program. It shows a working, artist-scale AI step in the animation pipeline.

items.title: 中, AI 악용·선정적 숏폼 드라마 연말까지 집중단속
items.excerpt: (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 중국 정부가 인공지능(AI)을 활용한 저질·선정적 콘텐츠 등 숏폼 드라마에 대한 특별단속에 나섰다.
items.rationale: New regulatory action: China launched a year-end crackdown on AI-abusing and sensational short-form dramas, the format where AI-generated output is growing fastest.

items.title: Camerimage Opens With a Robot, an AI Reckoning and a Minute of Silence for Kraków
items.excerpt: The 34th edition of Camerimage kicked off with  Luca Guadagnino's 'Artificial' and included honors for Darren Aronofsky and the THR Visionary Award for cinematographer Janusz Kamiński.
items.rationale: New event: the leading cinematography festival opened its 2026 edition with AI as the headline theme. This is the craft side's own forum on the technology.

items.title: iQIYI Reconstructs Lost 1938 Film Using NadouPro AI Workflow
items.excerpt: An eight-person team used iQIYI's NadouPro platform to reconstruct a 1938 film whose prints, reels and scripts had been lost, the company announced on November 6, 2026. The short, completed in two months, was shortlisted...
items.rationale: Concrete restoration result: an eight-person team rebuilt a lost 1938 film in two months on iQIYI's NadouPro platform. It shows AI applied to film heritage rather than new synthetic content.
